# Topic Desk Studio v0.3.2 — English

This update improves the reading layout, tab media controls, and topic search.

- Collapse and restore the topic list with a smooth transition and one icon-only control. The list starts at 420 px wide, remains adjustable, and restores its previous width when expanded.
- Show a speaker icon on playing tabs. Click it to mute or unmute a page, including background tabs.
- Stop audio and video when closing a tab. A login-state save failure no longer prevents closure; a native close failure keeps the tab available to retry.
- Fix search field text alignment and clarify that topic search matches titles.

---

# Topic Desk Studio v0.3.2 — 中文

本次更新改进阅读布局、页签媒体控制与选题搜索。

- 选题栏支持平滑收起和展开，统一为一个纯图标入口。初始宽度为 420 像素，可自由调整，展开时恢复原来的宽度。
- 正在播放媒体的页签显示喇叭图标，点击即可静音或取消静音，后台页签也适用。
- 关闭页签时停止音视频播放。保存登录状态失败不再阻止关闭；网页关闭失败时保留页签，方便重试。
- 修复搜索框文字对齐，并明确搜索范围为选题标题。
